d:
Two helicopters collided while attempting to land near Mount Everest in Nepal, killing 47-year-old Chennai resident Vasanth Kumar. Three others, including both pilots, were injured. A video showing the collision has also surfaced. Preliminary reports suggest a possible lack of coordination between the pilots or a technical malfunction. How did the two helicopters collide at Fereche helipad? And what makes flying helicopters in the challenging Himalayan terrain so difficult?
Video Editor: Mann
